oracle: the per-person reading detail is for the owner and editors (A18.4): the rules refuse viewers, views and acl to every other reader
what: the viewers/{uid} rule lets anyone who may read the document read it (firestore.rules and its template), so a viewer or suggester learns who read it and for how long

target.case: A18.4 the Activity panel's per-person detail is for the owner and editors only: rules refuse viewers, views and acl to a viewer, a suggester, an open editor and anonymous; the panel lists readers for the owner and an editor, only the aggregate for a viewer, and nothing for an open editor

expect.message: the per-person detail: owner, editor and approver read it; viewer, suggester and anonymous are refused
